apply: Read proposal, specs, design, and tasks before editing.
Implement only unchecked tasks and update tasks.md checkboxes as work completes.

Before any runtime-bearing apply, verify, or remediation launch, run `gentle-ai sdd-attempt acquire --cwd "/Users/ramiro/Desktop/projects/colloseum.feat-embedding-attempts" --change "automatic-supabase-embeddings" --request-id "<unique-request-id>" --work-unit "<label>" --evidence-goal "<stable-goal>" --max-attempts <count> --max-changed-lines <count>`.
Launch only for state proceed and retain its opaque token. State blocked or complete stops the launch; full runtime status is a diagnostic escape hatch, not normal model context.

After the external run, call `gentle-ai sdd-attempt settle --cwd "/Users/ramiro/Desktop/projects/colloseum.feat-embedding-attempts" --change "automatic-supabase-embeddings" --token "<acquire-token>" --request-id "<unique-request-id>" --outcome <passed|failed|interrupted> --evidence-revision <sha256> --diagnosis "<proven-diagnosis>" --harness-disposition <reused|invalidated> --cleanup-evidence "<evidence>" --process-evidence "<evidence>"`; add --successor-lineage only for a distinct approved remediation successor.
